trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: I wish the plot was more original, and I wish I read the book.
trap.right: I wish the plot were more original.
trap.why: Wish no presente usa passado/were; no passado usa had + particípio; para queixa de hábito, would. O brasileiro confunde os três.

opts: I wish the plot had been.
I wish the plot is better.
I wish the plot were better.
I wish I would read it.
I wish I had read it.

fix.wrong: I wish I watched the movie yesterday.
fix.right: I wish I had watched the movie yesterday.

fix.wrong: I wish the ending is better.
fix.right: I wish the ending were better.

fix.wrong: I wish he doesn’t talk so much.
fix.right: I wish he wouldn’t talk so much.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “I didn’t read the book.” (I wish…)
rewrite.answer: I wish I had read the book.
I wish the plot were original.

rewrite.prompt: Irritação: “He talks too much.” (I wish… wouldn’t)
rewrite.answer: I wish he wouldn’t talk so much.
